faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Novato?
faq.answer: Novato homeowners typically invest $5,500 to $13,000 for a full window replacement project covering 10–16 windows. This large Marin County city features a mix of 1950s–1980s ranch homes and newer planned communities in areas like Ignacio and Bel Marin Keys. Single window installation starts at approximately $510.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Novato?
faq.answer: Yes. Novato requires a building permit for window replacements. Our team handles all permit applications with the City of Novato Building Division on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Novato?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Novato commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Novato?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Novato replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Novato?
faq.answer: Most Novato projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
